AI situation briefing · Day 3, 14:00

  • Fire K-2041 grew about 60% since Day 2 and is spreading northeast with the wind. Community B (4,800 people) is now 3 km from the fire edge.
  • Community A moved to High because of smoke and a closing fire front. A smoke advisory also covers Community C.
  • Recommended now: open the reception centre in Community C, and alert care homes in Community B to prepare to move residents.
